# Branch and Teller Performance Monitoring

This document outlines key activities related to the assessment and improvement of operational efficiency within branches and for tellers.

## Key Initiatives:

*   Investigate branch efficiency on a quarterly basis.
*   Review branch efficiency based on audit findings.
*   Update teller performance quarterly.
*   Monitor branch efficiency to align with the 2026 strategy.
*   Review teller performance based on audit findings.
